name: 2016 Soquel Canyon–Point Buchon ROV observation and effort tables

producer.name: Marine Applied Research and Exploration for California Department of Fish and Wildlife

temporal.update_cadence: Static survey; quarterly access discovery until original row-level tables are reviewed

provenance.access_service: CeNCOOS historical data portal and advertised WFS/CSV downloads
transformations: CeNCOOS data-stream plan reports original CDFW .mdb conversion to CSV and PostgreSQL; transformed rows have not been inspected here.

evidence.supports: Producer reports 97.4 km post-processed at 33 sites and 12 study locations; original Access database, cleaned ROV tracks, sensor records, fish and substrate observations, effort and GIS lines were delivered to CDFW. These are report-wide totals, not qualified target counts.

CeNCOOS says CDFW .mdb observation and GIS data were made public through its portal, WFS and CSV; the plan distinguishes fish count, effort, depth and substrate fields. The current row-level download has not been verified.
CDFW describes the statewide ROV survey design and MPA monitoring context, not candidate-scale 2016 observation locations.
Live WFS reports 236,960 timecoded 2016 Central Coast video-position features, with site, dive, line and coordinates; it is not a fish-observation table.
Live WFS reports 49,076 aggregate fish-display features with count and taxa fields; it does not expose raw fish detections at video positions.

limitations: Public WFS video-position and aggregate fish-display layers are accessible, but the exact 2016 row-level fish/substrate table, cleaned track-quality record and source bytes have not been obtained or hashed.
No open-reference 200–300 ft observation has been joined to a qualified original bathymetry and habitat footprint.

Request raw/cleaned bottom position, position-gap and filter flags, uncertainty, taxon, timecode, depth datum, substrate, zero-detection segments, swept area, visibility and MPA/reference role before any spot-level use.
Publisher's historical public-access statement does not establish an exact redistribution license for SkipperCast derivatives.
